title: Secret Lair Drop Series: October Superdrop 2022
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Universes Beyond Secret Lair drops)

paragraphs.text: The October Superdrop 2022 is a superdrop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It was available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com from October 17, 2022, through November, 2022.
This Superdrop includes three drops adjacent to the Warhammer 40,000 . All are cross-over products based on Warhammer games produced by Games Workshop .
The superdrop also includes two drops made in collaboration with Post Malone .
Two drops are available in both English and Japanese versions.

The drops can be bought separately or in one of four bundles. The Post Malone Bundle for $108.99 features the two Post Malone drops in both foil and non-foil versions, while the Warhammer Bundle for $168.99 includes the three Warhammer 40K in both foil and non-foil versions. The Big Foil Bundle for $258.99 contains the eight remaining foil drops, while the Big Non-Foil Bundle for $168.99 contains the regular versions of those eight drops.

As an extra, each drop comes with a surprise bonus card. Except for the cases listed below, the potential bonus cards for these drops included various extended art slivers, blueprint cards, and borderless versions of Shadowborn Apostle .
